publicHero.description: A suitcase full of memories with BG Travel

ui.fallbackIntro: A special journey through the landscapes and local culture of {region}.

gobi.title: Gobi Journey
gobi.intro: A slow journey across the vast South Gobi, following dunes, rocky canyons and the traces of dinosaurs.

day01.title: Into the Gobi
day01.description: Leave Ulaanbaatar for Dalanzadgad across the open steppe, pausing at scenic viewpoints before meeting the expedition team in the evening.

day02.title: Yolyn Am
day02.description: Walk with a guide through the cool, narrow Yolyn Am canyon in the Gurvan Saikhan mountains, with time for photographs and rest.

day03.title: Khongoryn Els
day03.description: Experience the shifting patterns and immense views of the Khongoryn Els dunes, with an optional camel ride at sunset.

day04.title: Bayanzag
day04.description: Explore the red cliffs of Bayanzag and hear stories of the region's geology and famous dinosaur discoveries.

day05.title: Return to the city
day05.description: Stop at one final Gobi viewpoint before returning to Ulaanbaatar and completing the journey in the evening.

khangai.title: Khangai Journey
khangai.intro: A Khangai escape filled with clear mountain air, quiet lakeshores and encounters with local life.

day01.title: Toward Khangai
day01.description: Travel from Ulaanbaatar toward Arkhangai and watch the landscape change from steppe to mountain country.

day02.title: Khorgo Crater
day02.description: Take a guided walk around the volcanic crater and the surrounding lava formations.

day03.title: Terkhiin Tsagaan Lake
day03.description: Walk along the lakeshore and enjoy changing views of water, forest and mountains.

day04.title: Local life
day04.description: Visit a herder family to learn about seasonal work and nomadic traditions over local tea and food.

day05.title: Across Khangai
day05.description: Follow river valleys and mountain foothills toward Ovorkhangai, stopping at natural landmarks along the way.

day06.title: The road home
day06.description: Visit a final scenic stop in Khangai before returning to Ulaanbaatar.

tavanBogd.title: Tavan Bogd Adventure
tavanBogd.intro: An adventure combining the high Mongolian Altai, glaciers and the generous hospitality of Kazakh communities.

day01.title: Olgii town
day01.description: Arrive in Bayan-Olgii, meet your guide and review the route, weather and high-altitude equipment.

day02.title: Altai Valley
day02.description: Drive into the Altai foothills through rivers and high pastures, with a possible visit to an eagle hunter family.

day03.title: The highland road
day03.description: Travel toward Altai Tavan Bogd National Park through vast high valleys and mountain scenery.

day04.title: Glacier views
day04.description: Hike toward Potanin Glacier, adapting the route to weather, trail safety and the group's condition.

day05.title: A day in the mountains
day05.description: Explore the foothills and nearby valleys at a gentler pace, with time for photography and nature watching.

day06.title: Return to Olgii
day06.description: Descend from the mountains to Bayan-Olgii, stopping at scenic points and enjoying local food.

day07.title: Journey's end
day07.description: Transfer to the airport or onward transport point and conclude the expedition.

terelj.title: Terelj Escape
terelj.intro: A short escape from the city to relax among forests, rock formations and a peaceful river valley.

day01.title: Arrive in Terelj
day01.description: Leave Ulaanbaatar, stop at Turtle Rock and spend a relaxed afternoon in the river valley.

day02.title: Valley and monastery
day02.description: Walk the trail to Aryabal monastery through forest, rocky mountains and wide valley views.

day03.title: Morning horse ride
day03.description: Choose an optional guided horse ride before returning to Ulaanbaatar after lunch.

gobiKhangai.title: Gobi & Khangai Journey
gobiKhangai.intro: A long route joining two natural worlds, from the red rocks and golden sands of the Gobi to the green valleys of Khangai.

day01.title: South to the Gobi
day01.description: Leave Ulaanbaatar for the Gobi and meet your guide for an introduction to the route.

day02.title: Yolyn Am
day02.description: Walk through Yolyn Am and discover its rocky mountains, narrow canyon and cool microclimate.

day03.title: Khongoryn Els
day03.description: Explore the great dunes and open valley, with an optional camel ride.

day04.title: Bayanzag
day04.description: Walk among the flaming cliffs and learn about dinosaur discoveries and local geology.

day05.title: Transition to Khangai
day05.description: Travel north as the golden desert gradually gives way to mountains and river valleys.

day06.title: Khangai Valley
day06.description: Walk through green pastures and along the river while learning about local life.

day07.title: Mountain rest
day07.description: Enjoy a gentle foothill walk and free time for photography or rest by the valley.

day08.title: Back to Ulaanbaatar
day08.description: Return to Ulaanbaatar after breakfast and conclude the journey.

japan.title: Japan Ryokan & Culture
japan.intro: A journey combining traditional ryokan stays, cuisine, cities and Japanese culture.

kenya.title: Kenya Private Safari
kenya.intro: A private guided safari through Kenya's wildlife and spectacular landscapes.

morocco.title: Morocco Atlas Journey
morocco.intro: Discover the Atlas Mountains, ancient settlements and Moroccan culture.

italyWedding.title: Italy Wedding Journey
italyWedding.intro: A special wedding journey through Italy's beautiful cities and coastlines.

greekHoneymoon.title: Greek Island Honeymoon
greekHoneymoon.intro: A romantic honeymoon moving at an easy pace through the Greek islands.

rainforest.title: Rainforest Couple Retreat
rainforest.intro: A nature-rich retreat for two in Brazil's rainforest.
